blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 44-year-old farmer allegedly hacked and wounded his 58-year-old neighbor, a barangay tanod, after an argument over the noise of the farmer’s motorcycle when it recently passed by the tanod’s house. The attack happened on Monday, October 19, around 5:30 p.m. in Sitio Lutak, Brgy. Tinabyonan, Catmon town in northern Cebu. As of this posting, a complaint of frustrated murder has already been filed against the farmer, who was arrested and detained at the Catmon Police Station.
